svg.title: Walking time to the nearest public school and primary health care unit, Caruaru
svg.desc: Two maps of the urban area of Caruaru covered by hexagons coloured by the walking time from each cell to the nearest public school, on the left, and to the nearest primary health care unit, on the right. The centre and most neighbourhoods are within 10 minutes of both; cells at the edges of the city, and the rural ones around it, are 20 minutes or more from the nearest health unit.
